about.title: About
about.text: Backend developer focused on Python and Django. I design and build server-side applications and RESTful APIs with clean data models and reliable integration between services and clients. Having worked on both sides of the stack, I know what front-end teams need from an API and deliver contracts that are easy to consume. Studying at the Mechanics-Mathematics Faculty of BSU gives me a strong foundation in algorithms and problem solving.

bullets: Built back-end services and RESTful APIs with Python and Django for client web applications.
Designed endpoints and data contracts that front-end apps consume easily.
Structured projects for scalability, readability and long-term maintainability.
Turned client requirements into effective technical solutions.
Built React interfaces on top of my own APIs to deliver features end to end.
Built data-driven apps with filtering, search, pagination and validation on top of a REST API.
Developed a Python human pose analysis application working with datasets and images.
Implemented async data fetching, error handling and request validation (zod).
Built a real-time parking availability service (MyParking) in a team at a hackathon.

items.parking: Real-time parking availability service built at a hackathon. React + Yandex Maps API client showing free parking spots live.
items.pose: Human pose analysis application: detects body keypoints, processes images and analyzes movement using computer vision on datasets.
items.notion: Multi-user notes app on a REST API (json-server): user management, notes CRUD, pagination, search, sorting. State handled with Redux.
items.ts: Async filterable list rewritten from JavaScript to TypeScript: typed data fetching, user-based filtering, robust error handling.
